text:
maria: Draft RN + internal announce ready. PTAL. Target deploy Wed 03:00 UTC (change window 03:00-04:00). Link to draft: <https://docs.internal/rn/2490012345|RN draft>. TL;DR: model v3.4.1 pin, canary -> full rollout, minor infra DB index tweak (non-blocking), fallback to v3.3.9.

chris: Quick Q: rollback steps? Can we auto-fallback to v3.3.9 on error 5xx spike? Need runbook link & who is on-call.

maria: Yes — runbook is pasted below. On-call is @oliver until 04:30 UTC. We have an automated policy: if 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained for 2 mins -> deploy-bot triggers rollback to pinned v3.3.9. Manual rollback command in ops toolkit:

```
deploy-bot rollback --service=api --to=redwood/model:v3.3.9 --reason="post-deploy 5xx spike"
```

deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK: All preflight checks PASS. Canary capacity: 10% requests. Health probes OK. Estimated roll-forward time 4m.

oliver: Can we make the canary slightly longer? Suggest 15m instead of 5m for this one due to DB tweak.

maria: Agree. Updated plan: canary 15m, monitor latency & 5xx. I've updated RN and internal announce copy. Internal blurb (short):

"What's changing: model pinned to v3.4.1 for inference improvements; small DB index added to improve shard lookup; no schema migration downtime.
When: Wed 03:00 UTC
What to expect: brief canary then ramp, potential transient 500s — rollback auto-enabled.
Who to ping: #eng-oncall, @oliver, @chris, @maria"

samir: Can we get a one-liner for the #all-hands blast? Keep non-technical: 'Scheduled update to inference models to improve latency; minor maintenance window 03:00-04:00 UTC'

sarah: Legal/compliance: please confirm logs retention or any KMS/HSM key rotation impact. Also confirm no user data leaves VPC.

maria: Confirmed: no data egress. Logs retention unchanged. No key rotations in this window. Added sentence in RN & internal message. Updated doc: <https://docs.internal/rn/2490012345|RN draft>.

chris: LGTM. I'll be watching canary. If nothing pops at 15m I'll kick full rollout.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks. Final checklist: RN published, internal announce queued to go at T-30m, on-call notified, canary=15m, auto-rollback threshold set. Anyone object?

oliver: No objections. +1 from infra.
